en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a bearded man in traditional clothing standing indoors near a doorway and window, heavily bound in large chains around his shoulders and wrists, with shackles on his feet. Below the photograph is a printed caption in Bulgarian using pre‑1945 orthography, describing the person (Ivanitsa Danchev) and his imprisonment. At the very bottom, in Latin script, it reads: "Edition D. Voynicoff, Varna."
